# dsh-ee **Your company, inside every employee's Harness** Connect your ERP, CRM, data warehouse and policy docs, assemble them into AI micro-apps,
and ship them, reviewed and permissioned, to every employee's [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).
Data and credentials stay on your own server, and every call can be audited. English · [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) · [Español](./README.es.md) · [Português](./README.pt.md) · [हिन्दी](./README.hi.md) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue.svg)](./LICENSE) ### [→ Try the live demo, nothing to install](https://demo.hikariming.com/)
## Try it Open [demo.hikariming.com](https://demo.hikariming.com/) and pick a scenario: a 200-person sample company, Xinghe Tech, or a 4-person team serialising a novel, Shanhai Studio. Then pick a person. No sign-up needed. In the company: - **Zhou Hang, account manager**: see the customers he owns, which contracts are about to expire and who needs a visit, in *Customer visit brief* - **Chen Yi, expense accountant**: check expense claims and spot over-limit hotels and duplicate invoices in *Travel expense assistant* - **Zheng Xiaoyu, new hire**: see what to do in the first week in *Onboarding buddy* - **Liu Yang, IT lead**: see the ticket backlog and common issues in *IT service desk* You can also sign in as the admin (the account is on the sign-in page) to see how systems are connected, how apps are reviewed and permissioned, and how every call is logged. The sample company also ships three experts (renewal negotiation, contract review, expense audit), an expert team, and a block policy that keeps R&D out of the CRM. Open *Experts & connectors policy* as the admin and look up an R&D employee to see which rule hides what. In the studio, **Shen Mo, lead writer** checks the story's rules in *Lore Q&A*, and **Gu Qing, editor** tracks which chapters are due in *Chapter tracker*. The sample data is in Chinese. **Already have DSH?** Run `curl -fsSL https://demo.hikariming.com/setup.sh | sh` (on Windows, `irm https://demo.hikariming.com/setup.ps1 | iex`), pick an employee in the browser to approve the sign-in, then type `/customer-brief` in DSH and ask for a visit brief on 华东精密制造. The demo doesn't provide a model: DSH uses the one you've already set up. ## Three scenarios | Who | Asks in DSH | What the AI does | |---|---|---| | Account manager | "Huadong Precision renews next week. What should I watch out for?" | Calls the CRM: the contract ends in 21 days and there's been no visit in 75 days. Checks the product docs: renewals get at most 10% off, and anything more needs the sales director's approval | | Expense accountant | "Any problems in this month's expense claims?" | Calls the travel system, lists the 4 flagged claims, and explains each one against the travel policy | | New hire | "VPN won't connect, it says certificate error" | Walks through the IT troubleshooting guide step by step, and if that doesn't fix it, files a ticket (after asking you to confirm) | ## Who it's for - **For**: companies, from dozens to thousands of people, whose employees use or will use DeepSeek / DSH, that want the AI to work with their own systems and knowledge, and that worry about data leaks, uncontrolled access and calls nobody can trace. - **Also for**: small teams of a few people who use DSH together, such as a studio serialising a novel, a social media team or an online shop. They have no ERP to connect, but they share knowledge (a story bible, a brand guide, an after-sales policy), a few experts and a table or two that everyone edits. The demo has a team like this next to the company. - **Not for**: personal use; teams that only want a chat page in the browser; companies that don't plan to have employees install DSH on their computers. ## Why dsh-ee AI tools are easy to come by. What companies lack is a safe way to get **their own** knowledge and systems into every employee's hands. | Employees using AI tools on their own | With dsh-ee | |---|---| | Policies and metric definitions get copy-pasted into chats by hand | Policies, systems and data become capabilities that work as soon as they're installed | | Plugins and skills come from unknown sources, and nobody reviews them before install | Every package goes through automated checks and admin approval, and access is granted per department | | No record of who called which system from which machine | Installs and calls are written to the audit log, and anything can be unpublished in one click | | Useful prompts and workflows stay on one person's laptop | Skills that employees create go back into the company scope for everyone to reuse | dsh-ee is not an AI runtime. **Inference and tool calls run in each employee's local DSH.** dsh-ee prepares and governs everything DSH needs: capabilities, connections, data, models and policies. ## Features - **Capability hub**: plugins, skills, prompts, enterprise connections and micro-apps are managed in one place. Each has versions, an access scope (department, role or person) and a delivery mode (auto-enabled or opt-in). Enabled capabilities sync to employees' DSH automatically. - **Micro-apps**: a persona plus a workbench plus ingredients (knowledge bases, connections, skills, prompts), with optional app-owned tables. Employees open them in DSH with `/name`; apps can also be published as web pages that work on mobile. - **Experts, skills and connectors**: an expert is a role with a working method, example tasks and the skills, systems and knowledge it may use; experts can be grouped into a team. Admins manage categories, featured items and block policies, and can look up what any employee ends up with and why. - **Enterprise connections (MCP gateway)**: bring in ERP, CRM, ticketing and other internal systems as MCP servers or OpenAPI specs. Credentials are encrypted and kept server-side, never sent to employee machines. Every tool is authorized on its own, and every call is logged. - **Data hub**: shared datasets in a separate database, queried through a read-only account, with per-user parameters such as `:me_department`. Customers, people, products and other shared reference data live in one place. - **Knowledge base**: Q&A where every answer cites its sources, with no vector database involved. An agent runs several rounds of keyword search and reads the original documents. Supports PDF, Word and Markdown, with versions and rollback. - **Built-in npm registry with review**: hosting and publishing for the company scope, per-version review, and automated checks for install scripts, dependencies, licenses and leaked secrets. The company scope never falls back to the public registry, which blocks dependency confusion. Supports preloading packages from upstream and offline bundle import/export. - **OpenAI-compatible model gateway**: plug in DeepSeek or any other OpenAI-compatible upstream and expose one set of model names. A model can sit on several upstreams with automatic failover. Each account gets a monthly token quota and a list of allowed models. DeepSeek's beta FIM and chat-prefix completions are passed through as-is under `/beta/*`. - **One-command onboarding**: run `curl -fsSL /setup.sh | sh` (or `irm /setup.ps1 | iex` on Windows) and confirm a device code in the browser. A single unified token (`ee_at_…`) then configures the npm registry, models and capability hub. - **Third-party harness access**: register an API client (`client_id` / `client_secret`) per integration; CI or another harness exchanges it for a short-lived `ee_at_` token via `client_credentials` instead of holding an admin token. Scopes are capped by the owning account, the secret is stored as a hash and shown once, and every exchange is audited. - **Identity and governance**: local accounts plus LDAP / AD, RBAC, menus you can edit at runtime, an audit log, and analytics broken down by department, capability, model and endpoint. - **Runs on domestic infrastructure**: a single static Go binary for linux/amd64 and arm64. Runs on OceanBase or TiDB and works fully offline. ## Architecture ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph Sources["Existing systems & assets"] SYS["ERP / CRM / OA / Tickets
(MCP · OpenAPI)"] DATA["Data warehouse / BI
(datasets)"] KB["Policies · docs · skills · prompts · plugins"] end subgraph EE["dsh-ee (self-hosted)"] HUB["Capability hub
review · scopes · audit"] APPS["Micro-apps"] GW["Model gateway
quota · failover"] NPM["npm registry"] end subgraph Client["Employee device"] DSH["DSH
inference & tool calls"] end SYS --> HUB DATA --> HUB KB --> HUB HUB --> APPS APPS --> DSH NPM --> DSH GW --> DSH DSH -- "install & call records, new skills" --> HUB GW --> LLM["DeepSeek / other upstream LLMs"] ``` dsh-ee is **one binary**: the web UI is embedded, and a single port serves the UI, APIs (`/api`, `/v1`, `/mcp`), the npm registry (`/npm/`) and the DSH plugin index (`/index/dsh-index.json`). It needs a MySQL-protocol database (**OceanBase** in MySQL mode or **TiDB**) and a data directory. ## Quick start ### Offline bundle (recommended) The target machine only needs Docker and Docker Compose v2. No internet access is required. ```bash tar xzf dsh-ee--linux-amd64.tar.gz && cd dsh-ee--linux-amd64 sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS ./install.sh tidb # dsh-ee + single-node TiDB ./install.sh oceanbase # dsh-ee + single-node OceanBase (host needs 2 cores / 8 GB+) ./install.sh external # dsh-ee only; set DSH_EE_DSN in .env first ``` The first run generates `.env` (master key and initial admin password) and prints the admin password. **Back up `.env` together with the database.** If you lose the master key, the stored upstream credentials can no longer be decrypted. Build a bundle yourself with `make bundle VERSION=v0.1.0 ARCH=amd64` (or `ARCH=arm64`). ### Docker Compose ```bash cd deploy cp ../server/.env.example .env # set DSH_EE_SECRET_KEY (openssl rand -base64 32) etc. docker build -t dsh-ee:latest .. docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.tidb.yml up -d ``` ### Without Docker ```bash make build # → dist/dsh-ee (web UI embedded) DSH_EE_DSN='root:@tcp(127.0.0.1:4000)/dsh_ee' \ DSH_EE_SECRET_KEY="$(openssl rand -base64 32)" \ DSH_EE_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD='change-me-please' \ ./dist/dsh-ee ``` A systemd unit is provided in [`deploy/systemd`](./deploy/systemd). HTTPS, reverse proxies and the data hub database are covered in [deploy/README.md](./deploy/README.md) (Chinese). ### Connect employees On each employee machine: ```bash curl -fsSL https:///setup.sh | sh # macOS / Linux irm https:///setup.ps1 | iex # Windows ``` Confirm the device code in the browser, and DSH is connected to the company's capabilities and models. Inside DSH, `/ee-login`, `/ee-status` and `/ee-logout` manage the session. ## Configuration | Variable | Description | |---|---| | `DSH_EE_DSN` | **Required.** MySQL-protocol DSN; the database is created if missing | | `DSH_EE_SECRET_KEY` | **Required.** 32-byte base64 master key used to encrypt upstream credentials | | `DSH_EE_ADDR` | Listen address, default `127.0.0.1:8080` | | `DSH_EE_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN` / `_PASSWORD` | Admin created when the user table is empty (default user `admin`) | | `DSH_EE_PUBLIC_URL` | Public URL, e.g. `https://dsh.example.internal`; npm tarball URLs are generated from it | | `DSH_EE_COOKIE_SECURE` | Force the `Secure` flag on the session cookie; defaults to on when `DSH_EE_PUBLIC_URL` is `https://…` | | `DSH_EE_DATA_DIR` | Data directory (npm tarballs, caches), default `./data` | | `DSH_EE_DATA_DSN` / `DSH_EE_DATA_READ_DSN` | Data hub database (writable / read-only); `off` disables the data hub | | `DSH_EE_LOGIN_IP_LIMIT` / `DSH_EE_LOGIN_IP_WINDOW` | Failed logins allowed per client IP in a fixed window, default `50` per `15m`; `0` / `off` disables | | `DSH_EE_METRICS` | Set to `true` to expose `GET /metrics` (Prometheus text format, loopback / internal networks only); off by default | | `DSH_EE_CSP` | Content-Security-Policy mode: `enforce` (default when unset; built-in baseline policy for scripts/styles/images/connections plus the `frame-ancestors` embedding guard), `report` (`Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only`, report only) or `off` (explicit opt-out: only the existing `frame-ancestors` guard, i.e. the pre-upgrade behavior). Inline-script hashes are computed from the embedded `index.html` at startup; `frame-ancestors` is merged with `DSH_EE_EMBED_ORIGINS`. Invalid values fail startup. See [docs/operations.md](./docs/operations.md) §10.1 | | `DSH_EE_CSP_REPORT_URI` | Optional CSP violation report URL (`http(s)://…`); added as `report-uri` when `DSH_EE_CSP` is not `off`. dsh-ee does not ship a collector | | `DSH_EE_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | Reverse-proxy IPs/CIDRs (comma-separated) whose `X-Forwarded-*` headers are trusted; defaults to loopback only. Set it when the proxy runs in another container/host or behind a cloud LB | | `DSH_EE_REFRESH_TOKENS` | Opt-in OAuth-style refresh tokens (one-time rotation + reuse detection); default off, so no client behavior changes. When enabled, device/manual issuance also returns an `ee_rt_` refresh token and `POST /api/auth/refresh` is available (404 while off). See [docs/token-lifecycle.md](./docs/token-lifecycle.md) §3 | | `DSH_EE_REFRESH_ACCESS_TTL` / `_TOKEN_TTL` / `_FAMILY_TTL` / `_GRACE` | Refresh token TTLs and rotation grace: access `1h`, refresh idle `720h`, family cap `4320h`, grace `0` (strict) by default | | `DSH_EE_DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER` | Model provider (`name` or numeric `id`) used by the DeepSeek tool proxy — Files, ASR, TTS, Search, Fetch, OCR and the Anthropic-compatible Files API; defaults to the first enabled `vendor=deepseek` upstream. Calls are billed on the upstream account and do not consume dsh-ee token quota; see [docs/dev/deepseek-tools.md](./docs/dev/deepseek-tools.md) Also used by the DeepSeek beta passthrough (`/beta/completions`, `/beta/chat/completions`), which requires `vendor=deepseek`. | | `DSH_EE_DEEPSEEK_TOOLS_ALLOW_EMPLOYEE` | Allow **regular employees** (not only admins and bot/service accounts) to call the DeepSeek file/tool endpoints and reference `file_id` in chat; default `false` (employees get 403). Files live in one shared upstream account with no per-employee isolation — review the tenant risk before enabling | | `DSH_EE_SAFETY_CHECK` / `DSH_EE_CHAT_TITLE` | DeepSeek Chatbot options for `vendor=deepseek` Chat Completions upstreams: inject `safety_check` (`off`/`high`) and conversation `title` (`off`/`on`) when the client did not send them; client values are kept; both off by default; `/v1/messages` native passthrough is never injected. See [docs/dev/chatbot.md](./docs/dev/chatbot.md) | The full list is in [server/README.md](./server/README.md). ## Development Requirements: **Go 1.27+**, **Node 22** with **pnpm**, and a local TiDB or OceanBase. ```bash # 1. Database: single-node TiDB tiup playground v8.5.8 --tag dsh-ee --tiflash 0 --without-monitor --host 127.0.0.1 # 2. Server (creates schema and admin on first start) cd server cp .env.example .env.local # fill in DSH_EE_SECRET_KEY and the admin password set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a go run ./cmd/dsh-ee # 3. Web UI (proxies /api, /v1, /beta, /npm, /index to :8080) cd web pnpm install pnpm dev # http://localhost:5188 # 4. Optional: demo data (roles, employees, quotas, upstreams, a sample micro-app) cd server && go run ./cmd/seed ``` ### Tests ```bash DSH_EE_TEST_DSN='root:@tcp(127.0.0.1:4000)/' make test # Go integration tests (random DB per test) E2E_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8080 ADMIN_PW=… make e2e # Playwright end-to-end tests cd dsh-plugin && npm test # DSH connect plugin ``` CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) builds the UI, runs the Go tests against TiDB, runs the end-to-end suite against the single-file build, and builds the image. A separate `oceanbase` workflow repeats this on OceanBase. ### Repository layout | Path | Contents | |---|---| | [`server/`](./server) | Go server: auth, RBAC, LDAP, model gateway, npm registry, capability hub, MCP gateway, knowledge base, data hub | | [`web/`](./web) | Vite + React + Tailwind UI (shadcn/ui), Chinese and English | | [`dsh-plugin/`](./dsh-plugin) | `dsh-connect`, the DSH plugin that wires a client to dsh-ee | | [`deploy/`](./deploy) | Compose files, offline installer, systemd unit | | [`e2e/`](./e2e) | Playwright tests and real-DSH scenarios | | [`docs/`](./docs) | Design documents (Chinese) | ## Status dsh-ee is in early development (v0.x). APIs and schemas may change between releases. Known gaps: - OIDC login is implemented once an administrator configures an identity provider; local accounts and LDAP / AD also work. - DSH Desktop distribution reads the official release feeds, verifies sha512, and can mirror installers locally. - Single-instance oriented: login rate limits, caches and preload jobs live in process memory, and tarballs live on local disk. See the "Known limitations" section of [server/README.md](./server/README.md) for details. ## Community Scan the QR code with WeChat to join the dsh-ee users & developers group: ## Contributing Issues and pull requests are welcome. Please run the relevant tests before opening a PR. UI strings live in `web/src/i18n/{zh,en}`; the English file must mirror the Chinese structure, and missing keys fail `tsc`. ## License [Apache License 2.0](./LICENSE) dsh-ee is an independent project and is not affiliated with DeepSeek.

# dsh-ee **让每位员工的 DSH 都认识你的公司** 把 ERP、CRM、数仓和制度文档接进来，组装成 AI 微应用，审核授权后送到每位员工的 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)。
数据和凭据都留在你自己的服务器上，每一次调用都可以审计。 [English](./README.md) · 简体中文 · [Español](./README.es.md) · [Português](./README.pt.md) · [हिन्दी](./README.hi.md) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue.svg)](./LICENSE) ### [→ 在线试一下，不用装任何东西](https://demo.hikariming.com/)
## 在线试一下 打开 [demo.hikariming.com](https://demo.hikariming.com/)，先选场景：200 人的示例公司「星河科技」，或 4 个人的小说连载团队「山海工作室」；再选一个人就能进去，不用注册。公司里： - **周航 · 客户经理**：在「客户拜访简报」里看自己负责的客户、哪些快到期、谁该去拜访了 - **陈一 · 费用会计**：在「出差报销助手」里核对报销单，找出住宿超标、发票重复的单子 - **郑小雨 · 新员工**：在「新人入职助手」里看第一周要做的事 - **刘洋 · IT 主管**：在「IT 服务台」里看积压的工单和常见故障 也可以用管理员账号登录（登录页上有），看看系统是怎么接入、应用是怎么审核授权的，每次调用又是怎么记下来的。 示例公司里还有三位专家（续约谈判、合同审查、报销稽核）、一个专家团队，以及一条「研发部不开放 CRM」的禁用策略。用管理员打开「专家与连接器策略」，查一位研发部的员工，就能看到是哪条规则挡住了什么。 工作室里：**沈墨 · 主笔**在「设定问答」里查小说的设定，**顾青 · 责任编辑**在「章节进度」里看哪几章该交稿了。 **已经装了 DSH？** 在终端运行 `curl -fsSL https://demo.hikariming.com/setup.sh | sh`（Windows 用 `irm https://demo.hikariming.com/setup.ps1 | iex`），在浏览器里选一位员工确认登录，然后在 DSH 里输入 `/customer-brief`，问一句「给华东精密制造生成一份拜访简报」。演示站不提供模型，DSH 用的是你自己配好的模型。 ## 三个场景 | 谁 | 在 DSH 里问 | AI 做了什么 | |---|---|---| | 客户经理 | 「华东精密制造下周续约，我要注意什么？」 | 调 CRM 查到合同 21 天后到期、75 天没有拜访；查产品资料确认续约最多 9 折，再低要销售总监审批 | | 费用会计 | 「本月报销单里有没有异常？」 | 调差旅系统列出 4 张异常单，按差旅制度逐条说明哪里超标 | | 新员工 | 「VPN 连不上，提示证书错误」 | 先按 IT 排障手册一步步排查，解决不了再帮你在工单系统里建单（建单前先让你确认） | ## 适合谁 - **适合**：已经让员工用、或者准备让员工用 DeepSeek / DSH 的公司（几十人到几千人都可以），想让 AI 用上公司自己的系统和知识，同时担心数据外泄、权限失控、出了问题查不到。 - **也适合**：几个人一起用 DSH 的小团队，比如连载小说的工作室、新媒体团队、网店。他们没有 ERP 要接，但有大家共用的知识（设定集、品牌规范、售后政策）、几位专家和一两张都能改的表。示例里公司旁边就有一个这样的团队。 - **不适合**：个人使用；只想要一个网页聊天框；不打算让员工在自己电脑上装 DSH。 ## 为什么是 dsh-ee AI 工具不缺，缺的是把企业**自己的**知识和系统，安全地送到每位员工手里。 | 员工各自用 AI 工具 | 经 dsh-ee 统一下发 | |---|---| | 制度和指标口径靠员工自己复制粘贴进对话 | 制度、系统、数据封装成能力，装上就能直接问 | | 插件和 Skill 来路不明，装之前没人审过 | 每个包先过自动检查，再由管理员审批、按部门授权 | | 谁在哪台电脑上调用了什么系统，事后查不到 | 安装与调用记录回流审计，出问题可一键下架 | | 好用的提示词和流程留在个人电脑里 | 员工沉淀的新 Skill 回到企业作用域，供全员复用 | dsh-ee 本身不跑 AI：**推理与工具调用都在员工本机的 DSH 里**。dsh-ee 负责把 DSH 需要的能力、连接、数据、模型与策略备好、管住。 ## 功能 - **能力中心**：插件、技能、提示词、企业连接、微应用一处管理，每个都有版本、可用范围（部门 / 角色 / 指定人）与下发方式（自动生效 / 自己启用），启用后自动同步到员工的 DSH。 - **微应用**：人设 + 工作台 + 原料（知识库、连接、技能、提示词），可以自带数据表。员工在 DSH 里用 `/名字` 打开；也能发布成网页版，手机上也能用。 - **专家 · 技能 · 连接器**：专家是一个角色加上工作方法、任务示例，以及它能用的技能、系统和知识库；几位专家可以组成团队。管理员管分类、精选和禁用策略，还能查任何一位员工最终能用什么、被哪一步挡住。 - **企业连接（MCP 网关）**：ERP、CRM、工单等内部系统通过 MCP 服务或 OpenAPI 文档接入。凭据加密托管在服务端，不下发到员工电脑；每个工具单独授权，每次调用都有记录。 - **数据中台**：企业共用的数据集放在单独的库里，用只读账号查询，支持 `:me_department` 这类按人取值的参数。客户、人员、产品等主数据只存一份。 - **知识库问答**：不依赖向量模型，Agent 多轮关键词检索、读原文后作答，句句带出处；支持 PDF、Word、Markdown，文档有版本、可回滚。 - **内置 npm 源与审核**：企业作用域的托管与发布、逐版本审核，自动检查安装脚本、依赖、许可证与密钥泄露；企业作用域永不回源，防依赖混淆；支持上游预载与离线包导入导出。 - **OpenAI 兼容模型网关**：接入 DeepSeek 等上游后对外统一模型名，同名模型可挂多个上游自动故障转移，按账号分配月度 token 额度与可用模型；DeepSeek 的 beta FIM / Chat Prefix 补全按原协议从 `/beta/*` 透传。 - **一条命令接入**：`curl -fsSL /setup.sh | sh`（Windows 用 `irm /setup.ps1 | iex`），浏览器确认设备码后，统一令牌 `ee_at_…` 一次配好 npm 源、模型与能力中心。 - **第三方 Harness 接入**：按集成方注册 API 客户端（`client_id` / `client_secret`），CI 或其它 Harness 用 `client_credentials` 换短期 `ee_at_` 令牌，不必把管理员令牌交给对方；scope 受所属账号权限约束，secret 只存哈希且只显示一次，每次换 token 都有审计。 - **身份与治理**：本地账号与 LDAP / AD、RBAC、可在线调整的菜单、审计日志，以及按部门、能力、模型、终端统计的运营数据。 - **信创友好**：单个 Go 静态二进制（linux/amd64、arm64），数据库用 OceanBase 或 TiDB，支持完全离线部署。 ## 架构 ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph Sources["企业现有系统与资产"] SYS["ERP / CRM / OA / 工单
（MCP · OpenAPI）"] DATA["数仓 / BI 报表
（中台数据集）"] KB["制度 · 文档 · Skill · 提示词 · 插件"] end subgraph EE["dsh-ee（企业私有部署）"] HUB["能力中心
审核 · 授权 · 审计"] APPS["微应用"] GW["模型网关
额度 · 故障转移"] NPM["npm 源"] end subgraph Client["员工本机"] DSH["DSH
推理与工具调用"] end SYS --> HUB DATA --> HUB KB --> HUB HUB --> APPS APPS --> DSH NPM --> DSH GW --> DSH DSH -- "安装与调用记录、新 Skill" --> HUB GW --> LLM["DeepSeek 等上游大模型"] ``` dsh-ee 是**一个文件**：前端嵌在 Go 二进制里，同一个端口提供界面、接口（`/api`、`/v1`、`/mcp`）、npm 源（`/npm/`）与 DSH 插件索引（`/index/dsh-index.json`）。只依赖一个 MySQL 协议的数据库（**OceanBase** MySQL 模式或 **TiDB**）和一个数据目录。 ## 快速开始 ### 离线安装包（推荐） 目标机器只需要 docker 与 docker compose v2，不需要外网。 ```bash tar xzf dsh-ee-<版本>-linux-amd64.tar.gz && cd dsh-ee-<版本>-linux-amd64 sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS ./install.sh tidb # dsh-ee + 单机 TiDB ./install.sh oceanbase # dsh-ee + 单机 OceanBase（宿主机至少 2 核 8 GB） ./install.sh external # 只起 dsh-ee，连接已有数据库：先在 .env 里填 DSH_EE_DSN ``` 第一次执行会生成 `.env`（主密钥与初始管理员密码），并打印管理员密码。**`.env` 要和数据库一起备份**：主密钥丢了，已存的上游凭据就解不开了。 自己打安装包：`make bundle VERSION=v0.1.0 ARCH=amd64`（鲲鹏等用 `ARCH=arm64`）。 ### docker compose ```bash cd deploy cp ../server/.env.example .env # 填 DSH_EE_SECRET_KEY（openssl rand -base64 32）等 docker build -t dsh-ee:latest .. docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose.tidb.yml up -d ``` ### 不用 docker ```bash make build # 产物 dist/dsh-ee，已嵌好前端 DSH_EE_DSN='root:@tcp(127.0.0.1:4000)/dsh_ee' \ DSH_EE_SECRET_KEY="$(openssl rand -base64 32)" \ DSH_EE_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD='请改成至少十个字符的密码' \ ./dist/dsh-ee ``` systemd 单元在 [`deploy/systemd`](./deploy/systemd)。HTTPS、反向代理、正式环境数据库与数据中台的配置见 [deploy/README.md](./deploy/README.md)。 ### 员工接入 在员工电脑上： ```bash curl -fsSL https:///setup.sh | sh # macOS / Linux irm https:///setup.ps1 | iex # Windows ``` 在浏览器确认设备码后，DSH 就接上了企业的能力与模型。DSH 对话里可用 `/ee-login`、`/ee-status`、`/ee-logout` 管理登录。 - `ee_at_…` 是统一接入令牌，按账号 RBAC 与令牌 scope 取交集控制模型、npm 源、能力中心和企业连接；服务端只保存哈希。旧 `ee_npm_…` 与 `sk-ee-…` 继续兼容。 - 脚本把令牌交给 DSH 凭据库，不默认写入 `.env`。服务器或 CI 可用 `setup.sh --token <令牌>` 或 `DSH_EE_TOKEN`，这条兼容路径仍写 `$DSH_HOME/.env`。 - 升级前请保留原主密钥。回滚到旧服务端后，新 `ee_at_` 令牌不可用，需要重新使用旧令牌；新增表和列不会影响旧版启动。 ## 配置 | 环境变量 | 说明 | |---|---| | `DSH_EE_DSN` | **必填**。MySQL 协议 DSN；库不存在时会尝试创建 | | `DSH_EE_SECRET_KEY` | **必填**。32 字节 base64 主密钥，加密上游凭据 | | `DSH_EE_ADDR` | 监听地址，默认 `127.0.0.1:8080` | | `DSH_EE_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN` / `_PASSWORD` | 用户表为空时创建的管理员，默认用户名 `admin` | | `DSH_EE_PUBLIC_URL` | 对外地址，如 `https://dsh.example.internal`；npm 的 tarball 地址按它生成 | | `DSH_EE_COOKIE_SECURE` | 会话 cookie 是否加 `Secure`；`DSH_EE_PUBLIC_URL` 为 `https://…` 时默认开启，显式设置可覆盖 | | `DSH_EE_DATA_DIR` | 数据目录（npm tarball、缓存），默认 `./data` | | `DSH_EE_DATA_DSN` / `DSH_EE_DATA_READ_DSN` | 数据中台的库（可写 / 只读账号）；设为 `off` 关闭数据中台 | | `DSH_EE_LOGIN_IP_LIMIT` / `DSH_EE_LOGIN_IP_WINDOW` | 同一客户端 IP 在固定窗口内允许的登录失败次数，默认 `50` 次 / `15m`；设为 `0` / `off` 关闭 | | `DSH_EE_METRICS` | 设为 `true` 时开放 `GET /metrics`（Prometheus 文本格式，只允许本机 / 内网抓取）；默认关闭 | | `DSH_EE_CSP` | 内容安全策略模式：`enforce`（未设置时的默认值；下发内置基线策略 + `frame-ancestors` 嵌入收口）/ `report`（`Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only`，只报告不阻断）/ `off`（显式关闭：只加现有的 `frame-ancestors` 收口，即升级前行为，回滚用）。内联脚本哈希在启动时从嵌入的 `index.html` 计算，`frame-ancestors` 与 `DSH_EE_EMBED_ORIGINS` 合并；非法值启动失败。见 [docs/operations.md](./docs/operations.md) §10.1 | | `DSH_EE_CSP_REPORT_URI` | 可选的 CSP 违规报告地址（`http(s)://…`）；`DSH_EE_CSP` 不是 `off` 时写进 `report-uri`。dsh-ee 不自带收集端点 | | `DSH_EE_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | 可信反向代理的地址 / CIDR（逗号分隔），只有它们传来的 `X-Forwarded-*` 会被采信；默认只有本机回环地址。代理在别的机器、容器网络或云负载均衡后面时必填 | | `DSH_EE_DEEPSEEK_PROVIDER` | DeepSeek 工具代理（Files / ASR / TTS / Search / Fetch / OCR 与 Anthropic 兼容 Files）使用的模型上游：provider 的 `name` 或数字 `id`；不设置时用第一个启用且 `vendor=deepseek` 的上游。这些调用在上游账号按工具计费，不占 dsh-ee 的 token 额度；见 [docs/dev/deepseek-tools.md](./docs/dev/deepseek-tools.md)；DeepSeek beta 透传（`/beta/completions`、`/beta/chat/completions`）也用它，且必须是 `vendor=deepseek`。 | | `DSH_EE_DEEPSEEK_TOOLS_ALLOW_EMPLOYEE` | 是否允许**普通员工**（默认只有管理员与机器人/服务账号）调用 DeepSeek 文件/工具接口、在聊天里引用 `file_id`；默认 `false`（普通员工 403）。文件在上游是共享账号空间、员工之间不隔离，开启前请评估租户风险 | | `DSH_EE_SAFETY_CHECK` / `DSH_EE_CHAT_TITLE` | DeepSeek Chatbot 选项：对 `vendor=deepseek` 的 Chat Completions 上游请求注入安全审核 `safety_check`（`off`/`high`）与会话标题 `title`（`off`/`on`），客户端已传对应字段时保留；默认都关闭；`/v1/messages` 原生透传不做注入。见 [docs/dev/chatbot.md](./docs/dev/chatbot.md) | 完整列表、权限模型与接口说明见 [server/README.md](./server/README.md)。 ## 开发 需要 **Go 1.27+**、**Node 22** 与 **pnpm**，以及一个本地 TiDB 或 OceanBase。 ```bash # 1. 数据库：单机 TiDB（数据保存在 tag dsh-ee 下，下次同样命令会复用） tiup playground v8.5.8 --tag dsh-ee --tiflash 0 --without-monitor --host 127.0.0.1 # 2. 服务端（首次启动会自动建库、建表、创建管理员） cd server cp .env.example .env.local # 填好 DSH_EE_SECRET_KEY 与管理员密码 set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a go run ./cmd/dsh-ee # 3. 前端（Vite 把 /api、/v1、/beta、/npm、/index 代理到 :8080） cd web pnpm install pnpm dev # http://localhost:5188 ``` 除落地页与设备确认页外，所有页面都需要登录；账号用服务端首次启动时创建的管理员。 ### 演示数据 服务端起来后，可以补一份可直接演示的数据（角色、员工、机器人、额度、上游模型与凭据）： ```bash cd server set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a DSH_EE_SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD='你的管理员密码' go run ./cmd/seed ``` - 管理员：使用 `admin` 账号写入，所以需要它的密码（也可用 `DSH_EE_SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD` 显式指定）。 - 角色：「审核员」（看总览 + 审核能力）、「运维」（再加 npm 源与上游预载）。 - 员工：`zhang.wei` / `li.na` / `sun.hao` / `chen.yu` / `zhou.lei` / `wang.fang`，初始密码默认 `dsh-ee-demo-2026`，可用 `DSH_EE_SEED_USER_PASSWORD` 覆盖；其中 `wang.fang` 故意不分配额度，用来演示 429。 - 机器人：`rd-ci`（研发效能部 CI），负责人是 `zhang.wei`，每月 500 万 token，不能登录网页。 - 上游：「DeepSeek（官方）」与「内部模型网关」，`deepseek-flash` 同时挂在两个上游上，用于演示故障转移。 - 业务工作台：只读连接 `ee-catalog`（读 dsh-ee 自己公开的插件索引）和微应用「插件导购」（`plugin-guide`），设计见 [docs/workbench-panels.md](./docs/workbench-panels.md)。 - 凭据：每个演示员工与机器人各一个 `ee_at_`「演示接入」令牌；明文只在第一次创建时打印。 重复执行是幂等的。上游 key 默认是占位值（`sk-demo-*`），连接检查会失败；接真实上游时用 `DSH_EE_SEED_DEEPSEEK_KEY` / `DSH_EE_SEED_GATEWAY_KEY` 传进去。 ### 测试 ```bash # Go 集成测试（需要一个 TiDB / OceanBase；每个测试建随机库，跑完删除） DSH_EE_TEST_DSN='root:@tcp(127.0.0.1:4000)/' make test # 浏览器端到端测试：对一个已启动的服务（推荐用 make build 的单文件），需要初始管理员密码 E2E_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8080 ADMIN_PW=… make e2e # 或 cd e2e && node run.mjs registry 只跑一个 # 接入插件单元测试与真实 DSH 场景（需先 make build，并准备 DSH 与 Chrome） cd dsh-plugin && npm test cd e2e/dsh/scenarios && npm test ``` 每次推送 GitHub Actions（`.github/workflows/ci.yml`）会构建前端、对 TiDB 跑 Go 集成测试、用嵌好前端的单文件跑全部端到端测试、校验 compose 并构建镜像。`oceanbase` 工作流（手动触发 / 每周一次）在 OceanBase 上再跑一遍，本地也可以用 `scripts/test-oceanbase.sh`（需要 8 GB 以上内存）。 ### 前端约定 - 基础组件来自 [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com)（Radix），源码在 `web/src/components/shadcn/`；新增组件：`cd web && pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add <组件名>`。 - 确认操作用 `useConfirm()`（`lib/confirm.tsx`），不要用 `window.confirm`；提示消息用 `notify(msg)`（Sonner）。 - 可搜索下拉 `Combobox`、日期选择 `DatePicker` 在 `components/pickers.tsx`；数据表 `DataTable`（TanStack Table）在 `components/data-table.tsx`；悬停提示 `Tip` 在 `components/tip.tsx`。 - 多语言用 `react-i18next`：文案在 `web/src/i18n/zh/*.ts`（源语言）与 `web/src/i18n/en/*.ts`，英文按中文的结构写，缺键会在 `tsc` 时报错。按浏览器语言自动选择，选择记在 localStorage。 ###
